specs.Operating System: Mac OS, Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows Vista, Windows XP

features: Plug & Play Convenience - This Acer 6-button Computer Mouse features a matte finish, improved ergonomic curves, and a textured side for a comfortable grip. Its larger size fits medium to large hands, and the adjustable DPI with indicator light lets you effortlessly switch pointer speeds for smoother, more efficient performance

2.4GHz Stable Connection - The USB Mouse ensures stable, lag-free performance via a reliable 2.4GHz USB-A receiver (📌Located inside the mouse, open the battery cover and then you can find it). Just plug the receiver into your device and start working instantly - No drivers needed!
3-Level Adjustable DPI - Easily switch between 800/1200/1600 DPI settings to suit your task - whether it’s precise editing or everyday browsing
Effortless Browsing - With forward and backward buttons, this Wireless Mouse streamlines your workflow, making it easy to navigate through web pages and files with a simple click

💡NOTE: (1) The USB-A RECEIVER is stored in the battery compartment at the back of the mouse. (2) This USB Mouse need two AAA batteries, which are NOT included. (3) Transparency Protective Film on the Acer mouse's feet: For a smoother experience while moving it, please tear off the film before use.

Customer Support - At Acer, we prioritize quality and customer satisfaction. We offer 12-Month Support for the Ergonomic Mouse. If you have any questions regarding compatibility or usage, our support team is ready to assist you for a high-quality experience

Visible Indicator Light - Acer Mouse Wireless features a visual indicator for DPI levels and low battery alerts. The red light flashes once for 800 DPI, twice for 1200 DPI, and three times for 1600 DPI. When the battery level is below 10%, the light flashes red until the mouse is completely out of power [📌Note: Need 2xAAA batteries (NOT Included)]

Wide USB A Compatibility - Acer PC Mouse Wireless is compatible with most systems, including Win 11/10/8/7, Windows XP/Vista, Mac and so on. Suitable for laptops, desktops, PCs, MacBooks and other devices
